caption: Parco dei Mostri, Bomarzo
composition: Giant carved Orcus mouth in the Sacred Wood with moss and trees · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The giant stone face of Orcus fills the right of the frame, its gaping mouth forming a dark cavern, moss and ferns softening the weathered features, with the carved motto still legible across the upper lip. A woodland path runs off at the left under tall trees, and dappled 12:31 sunlight filters through the canopy. The staring eyes and the inscription make this the park's most unsettling encounter.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Bomarzo Monster Park under morning light
